newsitem.title: POLAND: Statoil to open 100 Polish petrol stations.
newsitem.headline: Statoil to open 100 Polish petrol stations.

text.p: Norway's state-owned Statoil will increase the number of petrol stations in Poland to 100 by the year 2000, Henning Rasmussen, the company's director for development, said on Thursday.
Rasmussen, quoted by PAP news agency, said Statoil would have 43 stations by the end of this year and that the company had invested about $60 milllion in Poland since its arrival in 1992.
"An average cost of building one station is $1.5 million," he was quoted to saying at a news conference in the western city of Poznan.
Statoil's Polish unit would increase staff to 1,200 by 2000 from 350 now.
